hint.label: First Nation

atoms.sound: Hello, my name is Asin. I'm a member of a First Nation community here in Canada. Growing up, my life was a mix of two worlds. Like any regular teenager, I went to high school, played video games, and still love listening to hip-hop. But connecting with my culture is also a huge part of who I am.

b: An Indigenous Canadian who does not feel connected to his culture.
A man from Canada who enjoys learning about indigenous cultures.
++An Indigenous Canadian living between two realities.

instruction.text: Höre dir Asins Schilderungen an und beantworte anschließend die Fragen.

atoms.sound: For us, culture isn't just something you see in a museum. It's alive! My grandfather taught me how important it is to respect the land, the water, and the animals around us. Every summer, our community gathers for a Powwow. It's a vibrant, energetic celebration filled with traditional drum music, dancing, and amazing food. It's a time when we feel proud of our culture and pass our traditions down to the younger generation.

b: It is a traditional dance competition with homemade prizes.
It is a traditional dish mostly served at family dinners.
++It is a traditional celebration of Indigenous culture.

instruction.text: Höre dir Asins Schilderungen an und beantworte anschließend die Fragen.

atoms.sound: At the same time, life isn't always easy. Indigenous people in Canada have faced many struggles throughout history, and our community is still fighting for equal opportunities today. But things are slowly changing. More young people are learning our traditional languages again, and we are sharing our stories with the world. Being Indigenous means honouring our past, but also building a bright future for ourselves.

instruction.text: How does he view his community within Canadian society?

hint.sound: <lang xml:lang='en-GB'>revive sth.</lang> bedeutet erneuern, wiederaufleben lassen

b: His community lives in perfect harmony with the rest of Canada's wider population and government.
They still have a long way to go before they can live according to their traditions again.
++It's not always easy but they have fought to revive their culture and traditions.

instruction.text: Höre dir Asins Beschreibung des Powwow an. Achte dabei auf den Tagesablauf.

atoms.sound: As usual, this year's Powwow began with the Grand Entry, where all dancers entered the arena in their traditional clothing as the drum group played. Next, the traditional dance competitions started, showing different dance styles and colourful outfits. In the middle of the day, intertribal dances took place, which allowed everyone else to step onto the dance floor and join in. After the dancing, visitors could walk around the grounds to buy traditional food like fresh frybread and look at handmade crafts. Finally, the event wrapped up in the evening with a closing ceremony where the drum group played the last honour song to thank everyone for coming.

frybread – frittiertes Brot
